title: Must both Claude and Codex work at launch?
body: This is the product requirement, before choosing an integration API. Supporting both lets you mix providers across leaders and workers, but adds two integrations to validate and maintain.
recommendation: Require both at launch, with configurable provider staffing. This directly supports the mixed-staffing question raised during charting; choose one provider if a smaller first release matters more.
options: Both Claude and Codex at launch

title: Who must be able to install v1?
body: A personal installation operated by you and a distributable tool installed by other people can face different authentication requirements. This choice scopes the runtime decision; packaging mechanics remain a later decision.
recommendation: Make v1 a self-hosted tool other individuals can install with their own provider accounts or credentials. Do not require a hosted service or centrally supplied provider access.
options: Self-hosted for me and other individuals
Only my own personal installation for v1
Include a hosted service for other users

title: Is usage-billed API access acceptable?
body: We are verifying which documented authentication routes each integration permits. This question sets your preference; it does not assume a subscription can be used through every integration. No credentials or payment are requested here.
recommendation: Prefer existing subscriptions where the chosen integration officially supports them, but allow API billing as a fallback with explicit configuration and spending limits. Never silently switch a job to a separately billed route.
options: Prefer subscriptions; allow explicitly configured API billing
Subscription-backed operation is a hard requirement
Prefer API billing for all factory work
